name: News Nest 1 - Semantic Backstory and Crosslinks

parameters.jsCode:
const articles = Array.isArray($json.articles) ? $json.articles : [];
return articles.map((article) => ({ json: article }));

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { content: { parts: [{ text: $json.embeddingText }] }, task_type: 'RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT', title: $json.title, output_dimensionality: 768 } }}
={{ { query: $('Prepare Vector').item.json.vector, filter: { must_not: [{ key: 'articleId', match: { value: $('Prepare Vector').item.json.articleId } }] }, limit: 5, with_payload: true } }}
={{ $json.hasRelatedContext ? { contents: [{ parts: [{ text: $json.backstoryPrompt }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.15, maxOutputTokens: 180 } } : {} }}

={{ { points: [{ id: $json.pointId, vector: $json.vector, payload: { articleId: $json.articleId, title: $json.title, slug: $json.slug, category: $json.category, summary: ($json.aiSummary || $json.subtitle || $json.content.slice(0, 700)), publishedAt: $json.publishedAt } }] } }}

={{ { backstory: $('Finalize Semantic Data').item.json.backstory, relatedArticles: $('Finalize Semantic Data').item.json.relatedArticles, isDuplicateEcho: $('Finalize Semantic Data').item.json.isDuplicateEcho, embeddingId: $('Finalize Semantic Data').item.json.pointId } }}
